# protocol_capture_golden.txt — Gen-3 PROTOCOL-EMISSION (level-2) golden.
# The RAW OMNISCIENT `|...|` protocol stream Showdown emits, verbatim, per battle.
# This is the byte-for-byte TARGET the Rust engine (protocol.rs) will reproduce.
# See src/rust_sim/PROTOCOL_EMISSION_DESIGN.md + tests/vectors/protocol_inventory.md.
#
# Record grammar (TAB-delimited headers; the L lines are RAW protocol bytes):
#   SCEN  <id>
#   TEAM  <id>  <p1|p2>  <packed team string>
#   BATTLE  <id>  <battleNo>  <seed m,n,o,p>   (the >start seed)
#   INIT  <id>  <battleNo>  <initSeed m,n,o,p>   (the pre-first-decision seed)
#   DEC   <id>  <battleNo>  <decNo>  <request:move|switch>  <forceP1> <forceP2>  <choiceP1> <choiceP2>  <seedAfter m,n,o,p>
#   L     <id>  <battleNo>  <lineNo>  <RAW protocol line, verbatim — MAY contain tabs/pipes>
#   END   <id>  <battleNo>  <ended:0|1>  <winner:p1|p2|tie|none>  <nLines>
#
# The L payload is the LAST field: everything after the 4th tab is the raw line
# (so a `|...` line with embedded tabs/pipes round-trips exactly). |t:| + |debug|
# lines ARE captured (the engine emits them) though poke-env ignores them.
